last_used_ms.description: Since the gateway started; not persisted.

oneOf.description: Acknowledge the pump's current alarm (NIBE alarm reset). Never sent unless enabled for hardware.

ControlLease.description:
A writer's lease on the heating offset (ADR 0123): if it is not renewed before `expires_at_ms`, the
gateway writes `baseline` back. Times are gateway clock milliseconds.

baseline.description: The offset read back before the first leased write; restored when the lease lapses.

holder.description: API key name, or "admin" for a browser session.

offset.description: The offset the holder last wrote.

pending_supersession.description: Owner supersession awaiting a dispatch outcome (requested offset, attempt time).

poll_rounds.description:
Complete, error-free passes over the poll list since start; update probation can end early
after one (ADR 0109). Absent without a hardware/replay adapter.

lease_seconds.description:
Optional control lease, 60..=3600 s (ADR 0123): unless the caller writes again with a lease before it
lapses, the gateway restores the offset read back before the first leased write. A write without a
lease ends any lease.

LeaseRestore.description: The last time a lapsed lease was handed back to the baseline.

ok.description: True when the restore write was accepted; the pump's read-back is the confirmation.

oneOf.description: The active lease, or one that lapsed and whose restore is still being retried.

remaining_s.description: Seconds until the baseline is restored; 0 once lapsed.

password.description: Omit or null to keep the stored password; empty string clears it.

available_commands.description: Controls the gateway configuration enables; only these accept MQTT commands.

base_topic.description: Base topic for this gateway, e.g. `nibe/nibe_a1b2c3d4`.

NetworkState.description: Domain-only network view; WS06 owns real NetworkManager operations and secrets.

register_notes.description: Per-installation notes set by the admin (ADR 0119); never grant write permission.

PollStatus.description: Continuous background reads (ADR 0102): one register per free read token, round-robin.

rounds_ok.description: Complete passes over the poll list in which every read was answered (update probation, ADR 0109).

slow_registers.description: Read about every `slow_interval_s` (counters, settings); they never count toward rounds.

RegisterDefinition.description: Metadata alone never grants write permission. WS04 supplies the real catalog.

display_verified.description: The value was checked against the pump's own display.

label.description: Short human meaning on this installation, e.g. "active fan speed step".

source.description: Where the classification comes from (survey, display photo, owner test).

max_age_ms.description: Freshness limit for this reading (slow-polled registers); `None` uses the gateway's `stale_after_ms`.

state.description: Evidence only; never grants write permission or establishes hardware verification.

Relevance.description:
What a register means on this installation, set by the owner (ADR 0119). Separate from the shared
catalog and from the automatic observation overlay: a note never grants write permission and never
changes either of them.

asset_size.description: Size in bytes of the signed release asset.

newer.description: True when this version is newer than the running gateway.

version.description: Semantic version from the release tag (`v` prefix removed).

checked_at_ms.description: Milliseconds since the Unix epoch of the last completed check, if any.

downloading.description: A download of the latest release is in progress.

enabled.description: False when the gateway was started with `--update-repository none`.

error.description: Fixed error code of the last check: `unreachable`, `no_release`, `no_asset` or `invalid_release`.

oneOf.description: Latest published release with a signed gateway asset, from the last successful check.

keep_history.description: Keep recorded history; otherwise it is erased with the settings (ADR 0114).

keys.description: Complete list of authorized public keys for `nibe-admin`. Empty turns SSH off.

version.description: Version shown by the last check; staging fails if a different release has been published since.

oneOf.description: Heating-offset control lease (ADR 0123); absent where leases are unsupported.

TemporaryLux.description:
NIBE "Temporary Lux" (menu 2.1): extra hot water for a fixed time, or one heating run.
On the F730 this is register 48132, raw 0..=4 in this order.

info.description: Authenticated local API. Cookie sessions and initial setup proof are documented in WS06. POST requests require X-Requested-With: nibe-gateway. Synthetic register IDs are not F730 addresses.
info.title: NIBE Gateway API

post.description: Admin session only. The token is returned once.
Admin session only. Ends all sessions and revokes all API keys.

get.description: Admin session only. SSH status and authorized keys (fingerprints) via the system helper.

post.description: Admin session only. Replaces the key list; an empty list turns SSH off.
Admin session only. Adds one public key (turns SSH on).
Admin session only. Removes one key by fingerprint; removing the last one turns SSH off.

get.description: Admin session only. Tailscale state via the system helper.

post.description: Admin session only. `logout: true` removes this device from the tailnet; otherwise only disconnects.
Admin session only. Joins the tailnet with a one-time auth key; the key is never stored.
Acknowledge the pump's current alarm (writes 45171=1, then reads back 45001). Hardware needs allow_alarm_reset (ADR 0105). The receipt means queued.

Heat offset -10..10. On hardware: 47011, only with allow_hardware_writes and 47011 in writable_registers (ADR 0104); the receipt means queued, confirm via the read-back. Never retry blindly. With lease_seconds the write holds a control lease (ADR 0123): renew by writing again with a lease before it lapses, or the gateway restores the baseline; lease state is in /api/v1/status. A leased write needs a fresh read-back of the offset (503 otherwise).

NIBE Temporary Lux (extra hot water): off, three_hours, six_hours, twelve_hours or one_time_increase. On hardware: 48132 (raw 0..=4), only with allow_hardware_writes and 48132 in writable_registers (ADR 0113, HP-32); the receipt means queued, confirm via the read-back. Never retry blindly.

get.description: Admin + active diagnostic lease required. Raw serial capture is sensitive and deliberately excluded from support bundles. WS04 capture-jsonl v1; only the configured recording file can be exported.

post.description: Explicit admin lease, 0 disables; max 900 seconds, confirmation AUTHORIZE_DIAGNOSTICS. Enables temporary verbose tracing and protected capture/dev access, never controls/auth bypass. Restart revokes the lease.

get.description: Allowlisted support JSON; excludes all logs, capture bytes, config, SSIDs, credentials, identity and free-text errors.

post.description: Authenticated read requests for explicit catalog IDs (settings included; never-write/alarm-reset entries excluded except 48852); max 32, one outstanding read, >=1s spacing, cancellable. Hardware requires the --allow-hardware-reads opt-in (ADR 0101). Never writes. No blind scans.
Collect passive observations only. Active probing is unsupported until a verified adapter is installed.

get.description: Bounded live SSE stream, not an event log. Fetch /api/v1/device on connect/reconnect and on resync; event IDs are process-local. Slow consumers lose old notifications without blocking the device.

200.description: JSON GatewayEvent notifications; resync after lag

get.description: Recorded history of polled registers (ADR 0114): raw 14 days, 15-minute 13 months, hourly 10 years.
Same query as /api/v1/history as CSV (one row per register and bucket).
Admin session only. MQTT settings (password never returned) and connection status (ADR 0115).

post.description: Admin session only. Saves MQTT settings to the persistent config and reconnects (ADR 0115).
Offline version-1 F730 JSON import into this process only (not persisted). All entries must be unverified and writes disabled. Clears prior observations; active probes must be cancelled first.

get.description: F730/replay only. Catalog metadata, passive observations, unknown raw values and discovery state, plus the saved observation overlay and this installation's register notes; every writable flag is false.

put.description: Admin session only; API keys get 403. Replaces or merges this installation's register notes (relevance, display check, label, note). Notes never grant write permission and never change the catalog or the observation overlay. Returns the stored set, also shown as `register_notes` in the explorer. Factory reset clears them.

post.description: Independent updater completes after gateway restart. Session expires on restart; log in again to inspect status.

get.description: Result of the last check against the configured GitHub repository. Never contacts GitHub.

post.description: Ask GitHub for the latest published release. Repeated checks within 15 seconds return the previous answer.

Download the signed release found by the last check and stage it exactly like an upload (signature, target and compatibility are verified by the updater). Only newer versions; activation stays a separate action.
Upload a signed version-1 release tar (max 48 MiB). Older versions require confirm_downgrade=true. Verifies and stages only; activation requires a separate explicit action.

parameters.description: Explicitly permit an older signed semantic version (default false)
parameters.name: confirm_downgrade

get.description: Application readiness: core heartbeat is recent on monotonic time and its worker is running. Wire recovery/failure makes readiness fail; physical frame silence is degraded and reported as last_frame_age_ms. OTA also matches version and release_id.
